messages:
Dana: Proposal: run a tiny 'dual-ack probe' tonight to validate active-active commit contracts under residency constraints. Idea: resident region returns an ack token (non-committal) and primary returns normal ack; reconciler compares tokens. Low blast, observational. Thoughts? :satellite:

Owen: Interesting. Different from simple shadowing since we produce a resident ack token that proves the resident path saw the intent. Must ensure token cannot be used to actually commit later. single-use, short TTL, KMS-wrapped.

Pri: Safety asks: 1) enforce X-Consent-Token for EU tenants 2) disable KV prefix cache for probe tenants 3) tag all traces with policy=dual-ack-probe-v1.

Mika: Telemetry: resident_ack_issued, ack_token_verify_failures, dual_ack_mismatch_rate, probe_latency_p95. Auto-stop if mismatch_rate > 0.03% for 10m or probe_latency_p95 delta > 250ms.

Dana: Rollout plan: staging canary -> 3k synthetic ops -> 0.5% prod for 3h -> 2% if stable. Primary rollback owner Owen, secondary Mika. ops-bot will schedule canary.

Owen: Token shape: base64(KMS(region).enc(JSON{intent_hash, tenant, nonce, expiry, sig})). Reconciler decrypts with resident-region KMS and verifies sig. comparator runs async to avoid adding latency.

Pri: Add header X-Probe-Policy: dual-ack-probe-v1 and X-Shadow: true. Resident ack must be 202/dry-run with X-Resident-Ack header containing escrow id. No writes performed.

Mika: Make sure comparator tolerates generation nondeterminism (strip timestamps, IDs). We'll set comparator threshold comparator_score > 0.02 = flag. Emit sample diffs for privacy review.

ops-bot: Canary queued: proxy/dual-ack-probe-v1 -> canary-77. Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/77 :rocket:

Dana: Privacy: privacy-bot, ensure any sample payloads are hashed and retention=7d. No raw PII leaves EU in plaintext.

privacy-bot: Confirmed. Samples masked (pii-hash) and retention applied. X-Consent-Token required; missing tokens excluded and counted in noncompliant_probe_count.

Owen: Small staging script for synthetic load:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 3000); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \
       -H "X-Consent-Token: eu:abc123" \
       -H "X-Probe-Policy: dual-ack-probe-v1" \
       -d '{"tenant":"t-900","op":"write-probe","data":"probe"}' \
       https://api.staging.redwood/v1/ops &
done
wait
```

Pri: Also add a control-plane flag to mark tenants in probe cohort so operator scripts can exclude them from bulk maintenance. Prevent accidental overrides.

Mika: If mismatch spikes, collect `request_id`, `policy`, `resident_ack_id`, comparator_score and pause the probe. We'll auto-pause if mismatch_rate threshold exceeded.

Dana: If successful, follow-up RFC: expose a "dual-ack" validation endpoint in the control plane so CS can request residency proofs for migrations. For tonight: manual canary.

Owen: I'll open the PR with proxy rule + reconciler wiring + dashboard. Will ping here when canary is live.

Dana: Thanks team. Let's keep the blast radius small and focus on clear observability. :white_check_mark:
